messages:
Jamie: FYI support just got a customer report — sustained 429s across multiple tenants, started ~09:12 UTC, looks like quota exhaustion despite low token usage in our graphs. :thinking_face:
SupportBot: Incident created: INC-202602-009, automated alert for limiter spike. Logs attached: /var/logs/ratelimiter/172834.log
SRE-Oncall: I'm looking. Can you paste the tenant IDs and examples of request IDs?
Jamie: tenant: acct-9342, acct-77b3. Example request-id: req_0a7f2c. Error body: `{"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":0}` — retry_after=0 for all responses.
Maria: retry_after=0 is a red flag. That suggests refill loop returned 0ms. Possible integer division or unit mismatch in the refill window.
Alex: Pushing a quick check on config: `limiter.refill_unit = \"ms\"` vs expected \"s\"? history shows a recent config change in rollout yesterday. Checking commit.
Kevin: Rollout 2026-02-01 18:20 UTC changed token refill unit from seconds->milliseconds in the feature branch `limiter-config-v2` (PR #1284). I think that's the culprit.
SRE-Oncall: For immediate mitigation, can we flip per-tenant override to disabled burst? `PATCH /admin/tenants/acct-*/limiter {"burst_enabled": false}` — will that prevent retries from being denied?
Maria: That will lower capacity but stop 0-retry-after. Also temporarily revert rollout flag `limiter.v2_refill_unit` to `false` in config service.
Jamie: Support can notify customers of temporary throughput reduction. Draft message: "we're applying a mitigation; you may see lower burst throughput for ~30-60m". :hourglass_flowing_sand:
SRE-Oncall: Executed revert for config flag: `cfgctl set limiter.v2_refill_unit false --env=prod` — propagated to all regions. Confirmed config hash: a1b2c3
Alex: Reverted PR on infra side to restore seconds-based refill. Rolling restart of limiter pods with graceful drain.
Linda: Patching an alert to detect `retry_after==0` and >5% 429s in 2m window.
Kevin: Adding regression test: TTL arithmetic with ms/s unit coverage and e2e to simulate burst windows.
SRE-Oncall: Postmortem: I'll create draft, assigning to @Alex (root cause), @Kevin (fix/CI), @Maria (mitigations/alerts). ETA for postmortem draft EOD.
Jamie: Customers notified, two PMs acknowledged. :white_check_mark:
SupportBot: Incident INC-202602-009 transitioned to mitigation; follow-up channel #incidents/1728341123 created.
SRE-Oncall: Next steps: backfill patch to convert existing configs safely, deploy canary then global. Schedule: canary in 15m, global 45m after canary healthy.
Alex: Pushed fix branch `limiter-config-fix` -> PR #1299. Will request review now.
Maria: Also add a metric `limiter.refill_unit_mismatch` when observed config differs from binary default.
Kevin: Will land unit tests and a changelog entry. :rocket:
SRE-Oncall: Closing loop — last 10m shows 429s returned to baseline. Monitoring for 1h before post-incident close.
Jamie: Thanks everyone. I'll update support ticket and close escalation if stable.
Linda: Filed alert runbook updates and added docs on config semantics.
Alex: Postmortem doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-202602-009 (link)
SRE-Oncall: :thumbsup:
